text: Hello boys and girls, welcome to our English class, I'm Huang Dingyi, nice to see you again.Today, we are going to compare our own diets with others.Before we start our lesson, please make sure that you have these things, your student's book, your notebook, worksheet and pens.请准备好你的课本,笔记本,学习单和笔。Are you ready?Let's start.I've got two questions for you.What do you usually have every day?What do you think of your diet?Please think them over.Here are the answers from my student Max.I usually have plenty of meat and a little rice every day.According to the food pyramid, that's probably not very healthy.Let's listen for what he thinks of his diet.I think it's unhealthy.It's good to know that he has realized his problem after learning about the food pyramid.What about your diets?Maybe STS 发 ZHope you can read them correctly.Kitty and Peter are talking about Peter's diet.Please look at task 2 on your worksheet.Listen to the recording and complete the table.Let's listen again.A little orange juice.Let's check.Peter doesn't have breakfast.What does he usually have for lunch?He has plenty of rice, some cakes and a lot of cola.What about dinner?Some chocolate biscuits and a little orange juice.How does Kitty ask about Peter's diet?Let's listen again and find out.Peter, what do you usually have for breakfast?I don't have breakfast.What do you usually have for lunch?I usually have plenty of rice, some cakes and a lot of cola.I usually have some chocolate biscuits and a little orange juice.When she asks about breakfast and lunch, she says,What do you usually have for breakfast or lunch?When she asks about dinner, she says,What about dinner?We can use these sentences to ask about others' diets.Now that we've known Peter's diet and how to ask about one's diet,suppose you are Kitty and Peter.Ask and answer about Peter's diet.Let's read the dialogue together.I usually have a little orange juice.What do you usually have for breakfast?I'd like to know about your diet.Please talk about what you usually have for breakfast, lunch and dinner.Let's look at Cindy's work.I usually have some bread and milk for breakfast.I usually have some eggs, some fish,plenty of vegetables and noodles for lunch.For dinner, I usually have some meat,a lot of rice and a little yoghurt.Her diet contains most of the food in the food pyramid,and the amount is proper.I think her diet is quite healthy.You've known about Peter's diet.Please compare your diet with his.I usually have some meat, some fish,plenty of vegetables and noodles for lunch.For dinner, I usually have some meat,a lot of fish,plenty of vegetables and noodles for lunch.Cindy compared her diet with Peter's like this.Let's read it together.My diet is healthier than Peter's,because Peter has too much sweet food.You know, there's a lot of sugar in the sweet food.Cindy has given a proper reason for her conclusion.Cindy對比較的結論給出了合理的理由。According to the food pyramid, we only need a little fat,salt and sugar every day.Peter has too much sugar.That's why Peter's diet is less healthy than Cindy's.We can add proper reasons for the conclusion of the comparison.Cindy talked about how much sugar Peter has while comparing their diets.Please think about the question.From what aspects can we compare diets?Please think about this question.In Max's opinion, we can think about the following questions when we compare diets.Is the food healthy?How much, how many does he or she have?How many kinds of food does he or she have?I agree with Max.His questions are based on the food pyramid.It's a good way to compare diets.I'm sure you also have great ideas.Suppose your friend Lucy is talking with you about what she usually has.Make a dialogue and compare your diets.Here's Lucy's diet.Remember to ask about what the other usually has for breakfast, lunch, dinner.And to compare diets.Try to give reasons from different aspects.【翻譯】Let's take a look at my student, Bill's work.Please read it together.Bill, what do you usually have for breakfast?I usually have some noodles.I usually have a little bread.I usually have some meat, plenty of vegetables and 饺子What do you usually have for lunch?I usually have a few vegetables and plenty of fruit.For dinner, I usually have some seafood and a lot of rice.What about you?I usually have some chicken and rice.Your diet is less healthy than mine.You have only a few vegetables, but I think my diet is healthier than your diet.I eat more kinds of food.Did they ask about what the other usually has for breakfast, lunch, dinner?Did they compare diets?Did they give reasons from different aspects?Brilliant!I believe you've also done a good job.In today's class, you've learned the pronunciation of the S in the plural form of some countable nouns.You've also learned how to ask about the food people usually have, and how to compare diets from different aspects.After class, please complete the exercises on your homework sheet.So much for today.See you next time.
